title: Q7
description:
“That He, by the grace of God, might taste death for everyone.”
Read: Isa 53:10–12
a) Isaiah says the Servant “bore the sin of many” and would “justify many.” What does Isaiah's Servant bring forward into Hebrews' “for everyone”?
b) What does “taste death” say about the Son's death being real and full, rather than apparent?
